history.content: where did harvey originate and when did it become an official hurricane

Hurricane Harvey originated from a tropical wave to the east of the Lesser Antilles and reached tropical storm status on August 17, 2017. However, it weakened and degenerated into a tropical wave north of Colombia early on August 20. Harvey redeveloped over the Bay of Campeche on August 23 and became a tropical storm again on the same day. It then intensified and became a Category 4 hurricane striking Texas on August 24.
Was Harvey the first hurricane of the season?
No, Hurricane Harvey was the eighth named storm and third hurricane of the extremely active 2017 Atlantic hurricane season.
How much rain fell on Texas during hurricane Harvey?

Hurricane Harvey dropped prolonged torrential and unprecedented amounts of rainfall over the Lone Star state causing widespread flash flooding. Many locations in the Houston metropolitan area observed at least 30 in ( 76 cm ) of precipitation, with a maximum of 64.58 in ( 164.0 cm ) in Nederland. This makes Harvey the wettest tropical cyclone on record for both Texas and the United States.
How many people died during hurricane Harvey?

As of August 29, 14 fatalities had been confirmed from flooding in the Houston area, including 6 from the same family who died when their van was swept off a flooded bridge and a police officer drowned while trying to escape rising waters. Harvey killed at least 90 people in August 2017 after making landfall in Texas. Also 1 death was reported in Guyana.
Did any cattle die in Texas during hurricane Harvey?
I do not have any information about cattle deaths in Texas during Hurricane Harvey.
Was there a lot of damage to homes?

The Texas Department of Public Safety stated more than 185,000 homes were damaged and 9,000 destroyed. Tornadoes spawned in the area, also damaged or destroyed the roofs of dozens of homes. Hurricane Harvey Strong winds and heavy rainfall also affected Suriname and Guyana homes. In Paramaribo the Presidential Palace, a Hotel and several homes suffered structural impact. In Guyana, the village of Jawalla bore the brunt of the storm. Homes demolished and damage to businesses, schools and the community center. A 29 - year - old woman died after her house collapsed on her.

Home computer
Introduced in August 1981 , the IBM Personal Computer would eventually supplant CP / M as the standard platform used in business . This was largely due to the IBM name and the system 's 16 bit open architecture , which expanded maximum memory tenfold , and also encouraged production of third - party clones . In the late 1970s , the 6502 - based Apple II series had carved out a niche for itself in business , thanks to the industry 's first killer app , VisiCalc , released in 1979 .
